name: fix-table-merge-picker
title: Fix table merge picker opening
description: Expose a visible searchable same-floor table picker and widen the table detail modal without changing merge business rules.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The detail modal is widened to 1240px within viewport limits. The merge section now receives an explicit Chọn bàn từ danh sách button, a direct Apollo-backed searchable same-floor picker, disabled states for tables already grouped, keyboard focus handling, and an empty native-button fallback. Legacy HMR listeners are disconnected and the duplicate old enhancer/test were removed. Schema, resolver, permissions, audit logging, mutation contract, and business rules are unchanged. Focused tests were updated but no local Vitest, build, browser smoke test, screenshot comparison, or CI workflow ran in the connected environment.
